run_extract_resnet152_features: run the script to extract ResNet152 features from images in a directory and save as numpy arrays
run_parallel_feature_extraction: run the script with total_group and group_id arguments to parallelize feature extraction across multiple workers
extract_image_feat: extract ResNet152 pool5 features from a single image file and return a PyTorch tensor
create_ResNet152FeatModule: create a ResNet152 feature extraction module that removes the final avgpool and fc layers for feature maps
get_image_id: get the numeric image ID from an image filename by parsing the last underscore-separated segment
